name: What are some common challenges in new home construction?

mainEntity.name: What are some common challenges in new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in new home construction include unexpected site conditions, such as unstable soil or rock, which can increase foundation costs and timeline. Weather delays can impact scheduling, especially during critical phases. Material shortages or price fluctuations can affect the budget. Permitting delays and managing various subcontractors also require careful oversight. Effective communication and a contingency plan are essential to navigate these potential hurdles smoothly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common challenges include unexpected site conditions, weather delays, material shortages, and permitting delays. Effective communication and contingency planning help mitigate these issues.
